title: AlphaSense Acquires Carousel to Power AI-Driven Excel Modeling
summary: AlphaSense acquired Carousel, an AI-powered Excel modeling startup, to automate financial model building and iteration with natural language. The deal adds dynamic modeling to AlphaSense's generative AI suite, enabling analysts to create and update models using insights from earnings calls, filings, and research reports.
whyItMatters: Adds AI-driven financial modeling to AlphaSense's platform, enabling analysts to build and iterate Excel models using natural language — extending its reach from research into workflow automation.
